title: Yellow Smoky Ukrainian Bresaola Frittata
description: A smoky and creamy Ukrainian dish featuring bresaola, perfect for a brunch mood, this frittata is made with beurre-monte and is low-sodium-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the beurre-monte in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced bresaola to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Pour the whisked eggs over the bresaola in the skillet.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
